items.title: The deposit cap
items.text: Dutch law caps the deposit at two months' basic rent, service costs excluded. Agents still ask for three. We don't let them.

items.title: Registration
items.text: A landlord cannot forbid registration at the address. Without BRP, a BSN and a bank account get hard. We confirm it in writing before you sign.

items.title: The points system
items.text: Many Amsterdam homes fall under the points system. An asking rent above the legal maximum is leverage. We run the check.

items.title: Service costs
items.text: "€1,800 + €250 service costs" often hides charges the law does not allow. We separate legitimate from padding.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: Since 2024 the default contract is indefinite. Fixed-term offers are the exception, with conditions. We check which one you are handed.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: New job, freelance, non-euro salary: each has a right way to be presented. We write it so a Dutch landlord reads it as safe.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Amsterdam, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency. In the Netherlands the role is called aanhuurmakelaar: hired by the tenant, paid by the tenant only.
Expats and internationals relocating to Amsterdam — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English. The motivation letter goes in Dutch and English.
No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.

Dutch-format dossier within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings with live video and written report, negotiation, contract check against Dutch law, BRP confirmed in writing.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date.

items.q: Isn't it illegal for agents to charge tenants in the Netherlands?
items.a: It is illegal for an agent to charge you when they also act for the landlord — what most "free" agencies do. An agent you hire, who works only for you, may charge you for the work. BOOM Amsterdam is that agent (aanhuurmakelaar): hired and paid by the tenant only.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Amsterdam from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the contract, and confirm in writing that you can register (BRP) at the address, before you sign.

items.q: How fast will I have an apartment?
items.a: Budget and move-in date decide it. A complete Dutch-format dossier and applications sent as listings appear are what shorten it. Nobody can promise a date in Amsterdam. Anyone who does is selling you something else.

items.q: Do I need to be in Amsterdam?
items.a: No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the BRP appointment.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.
By card on this page (Stripe) when you start; the invoice comes from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: Used to answer you and run your search; if you stop at the payment, we ask once whether you have questions. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it; invoices and payment records stay, as the law requires.

footer.statement: BOOM Amsterdam acts solely as a tenant-side search agent (aanhuurmakelaar). We do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents.
